stories.title: Sources: Bucs, Mayfield reach 3-year extension
stories.summary: The Buccaneers and quarterback Baker Mayfield have agreed to a three-year extension, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: 24-team CFP on table as ESPN window to open, sources say
stories.summary: Leaders of the College Football Playoff on Tuesday agreed to open a 30-day negotiating window with sole rights holder ESPN. Opening the window will help determine if a 24-team field is a worthwhile endeavor.

stories.title: Rams star Donald won't travel to Australia, out against 49ers
stories.summary: Rams standout defensive tackle Aaron Donald will not travel to Australia for Thursday night's opener against the San Francisco 49ers and will be inactive, coach Sean McVay announced Tuesday.
